title: Act: Confirm AdminApp 401 branch covers Retry and Reject
summary: Confirm runExecutionAction sends every 401 through handleError
description: Read AdminApp.runExecutionAction and confirm the 401 branch applies to approve, retry and reject alike; no code change is expected unless a gap is found.
acceptance_criteria: Given any execution action returns 401, when runExecutionAction catches it, then handleError clears the token and sets gateError 'Invalid token'
Given a non-401 error, when caught, then handleError is not called

steps.action: Confirm the catch block calls handleError(err) and returns when err is an ApiError with status 401, for any action function passed in; change nothing if so.
steps.expected: Retry, Approve and Reject all share the same 401 path
